overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a note passed from one member to the committee's non-member counsel was not deliberation because no quorum took part.

allegations.summary: Alleged that a committee member secretly passed a note to the committee's counsel during a meeting, constituting private deliberation with all members through counsel.
allegations.key_passage: because a quorum of the Committee did not participate in the communication.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
